verdict.rationale: A probe confirmed a genuine llms.txt (HTTP 200) on the www origin, listing the registered-agent, annual-report, and software surfaces with one-line descriptions. A public, keyless OpenAPI spec also gives agents a machine-readable API description, so a user can point an agent at agent-oriented material. The llms.txt is thin and centred on marketing pages, and the developer portal is a JS-rendered app shell that is less accessible to agents. missing for 10: llms.txt coverage of the API and developer docs (or an llms-full.txt), agent-readable static developer docs, independent or hands-on corroboration of agent use.
